name: StartPos Editor
description: Add, move and remove start positions in any level, including RobTop levels.

enable-switcher.name: Enable built-in StartPos Switcher
enable-switcher.description: Cycle start positions while playing with the previous/next keys and on-screen arrows. Automatically turned off if Capeling's Startpos Switcher is loaded, to avoid a conflict.

previous-startpos.name: Previous Start Position
previous-startpos.description: Switch to the previous start position, wrapping around. Index 0 is start from 0%.

next-startpos.name: Next Start Position
next-startpos.description: Switch to the next start position, wrapping around. Index 0 is start from 0%.

hide-switcher-buttons.name: Hide Switcher Buttons
hide-switcher-buttons.description: Hides the on-screen left and right arrow buttons. The index label and keybinds still work.

switcher-opacity.name: Switcher Idle Opacity
switcher-opacity.description: How visible the switcher stays after it fades. 0 is invisible, 100 is fully visible. After the level starts or you switch start position, it shows at full opacity for half a second, then fades to this value.
